usage_notes: The interrogative pronoun ai is used for a person. When ai functions as the subject of the question, it is placed at the beginning of the question.
― Who has a car?
When functioning as the predicate, it can either follow or predate the linking verb
― Who is Hải?
― Who is Hải?
When functioning as the object, it is placed after the verb.
― Whom is Nga drawing?
